agent_notes: Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; after confirming the expected public hostnames, public GETs used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.
The NIRF 2025 Engineering listing contains the exact institution name, Kanpur city, and Uttar Pradesh state.

The official contact page confirms Awadhpuri (Opp. Rama Dental College), Kanpur - 208024. The official site does not explicitly name the administrative district as Kanpur Nagar, so district remains null pending an official district source.

The official catalogue is internally inconsistent: the homepage describes five B.Tech. and three diploma programmes, while the degree admissions page lists six B.Tech. branches including Computer Science & Engg. (AI & ML). The diploma page's eligibility text mentions Electronics Engg. as a three-year diploma, but its availability list and homepage list only Architecture Assistantship, Computer Sc. & Engg, and MOM&SP; Electronics diploma is retained as a manual-review programme-family candidate and must not be auto-imported without resolving the conflict.
No certificate or doctoral programme was listed on the official academic programme pages.
